title: Vague hero copy
summary: Hero headline is a slogan, not a value proposition, failing to communicate product benefits.
problem: The hero headline 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' is abstract and doesn't mention shoes or key benefits, failing to answer visitor intent.
recommended_change: h1: Comfortable, Sustainable Shoes for Every Day; cta: Shop Best Sellers; notes: Plain-language headline that states the product and key benefits. CTA directs to a specific, popular collection to reduce choice overload.
evidence: H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.'; CTAs: 'Shop All', 'Shop Womens', 'Shop Mens'
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Multiple competing CTAs
summary: Hero has multiple CTAs without hierarchy, causing decision paralysis.
problem: The homepage presents multiple primary CTAs without a clear hierarchy, diluting the primary conversion path and causing decision paralysis.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Primary: Shop Bestsellers (or Shop All) with secondary links to Men/Women; notes: Consolidate to one primary CTA that guides the majority of users to the most popular products, with secondary CTAs for specific segments.
evidence: CTAs list includes 'Shop All', 'Shop Womens', 'Shop Mens', 'Shop Socks', 'Shop Women's Sale', 'Shop Men's Sale' all on the same page, with no visual hierarchy indicated.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Shipping delay warning
summary: Prominent shipping delay warning creates hesitation and may drive users away.
problem: The prominent 'orders may take up to 30 days to ship' warning creates immediate hesitation and may drive users away before they see the value proposition.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Soften the message: 'Free shipping on orders over $100. Note: some orders may take up to 30 days due to high demand.' Add a link to a 'Shipping FAQ' or a reassurance like 'We'll keep you updated.'
evidence: Body sample: 'Due to increased demand, orders may take up to 30 days to ship.'
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Free shipping threshold hidden
summary: Free shipping threshold only in announcement bar, not hero, creating expectation gap.
problem: The hero promotes free shipping but the $100 threshold is only in the announcement bar, creating an expectation gap.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural. Free Shipping Over $100.; cta: Shop All; notes: Include threshold in hero to set expectations early.
evidence: Hero copy: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' and announcement bar: 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100'
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Mega-menu choice overload

problem: The mega-menu presents 20+ items across multiple categories, overwhelming users and increasing cognitive load, leading to choice paralysis.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Simplify mega-menu to top 5-7 key categories, use clear hierarchy, and reduce number of links per panel to avoid overwhelming users.

title: Missing size selector

problem: The product page for 'Anytime Ankle Sock' lacks a visible size selector or add-to-cart button, preventing users from completing a purchase.
recommended_change: h1: Anytime Ankle Sock; cta: Add to Cart; notes: Ensure a size selector (e.g., S/M/L) and a prominent 'Add to Cart' button are present on the product page to enable purchase.

title: No responsive viewport
summary: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile users see a scaled-down desktop layout, hurting usability.
problem: The absence of a viewport meta tag causes mobile browsers to render the desktop layout scaled down, making tap targets too small and harming mobile conversion.
recommended_change: notes: Add a viewport meta tag to ensure proper scaling on mobile devices.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no viewport meta tag found.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Unclear pricing and hidden costs
summary: Product pages show only base price without shipping info, causing surprise at checkout.
problem: Product pages display only the base price without clear shipping costs, leading to cart abandonment when users encounter unexpected fees.
recommended_change: h1: Anytime Ankle Sock; cta: Add to Cart; notes: Display 'Free shipping on orders over $100' or a shipping cost estimate near the price, and consider showing a total cost estimate including tax and shipping before checkout.
evidence: On the product page for 'Anytime Ankle Sock', prices list includes '$16' multiple times, but no mention of shipping costs or thresholds. | The header shows 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100' but this is not repeated on the product page.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Missing product-specific CTA
